india_trends.title: GST on MDR will not impose additional burden on merchants: NPCI explains how they can adjust it against tax liability
india_trends.summary: UPI MDR of 0.4% will apply to P2M transactions above ₹2,000 from 15 October. NPCI says GST paid on MDR can be adjusted against GST payable on sales through input tax credit. Small merchants with monthly UPI receipts up to ₹1 lakh will continue to have zero MDR.

india_trends.title: India-Canada CEPA: Fifth round of trade talks to begin Oct 5; Goyal says next 90 days ‘defining’ for bilateral ties
